tweets.text:
🚨BREAKING: CARTEL LEADER “J3” CAPTURED🚨

NOGALES, SONORA, Mexico — Dual U.S. and Mexican national Juan Jose Jacobo Regalado — aka "El J3” — arrested over the weekend by the ICE Homeland Security Investigations vetted unit (TCIU) within the Fiscalia General de la Republica, Agencia de Investigacion Criminal, supported by the Mexican Secretaria de la Defensa Nacional.

J3 was the leader of “Los Demonios,” a violent faction of the Sinaloa Cartel responsible for hundreds of homicides and smuggling drugs across the U.S. Mexico border.

He is the third member of the leadership ranks of Los Demonios arrested in the last month thanks to the Government of Mexico and ICE HSI collaboration.

The arrest represents another significant win in joint U.S. – Mexico efforts to dismantle violent cartels, keep the border secure, and protect our communities.

SAN JUAN, Puerto Rico — Our multiagency team arrested 53 Dominican illegal aliens during a large-scale worksite enforcement operation May 8.

👉All 53 illegal aliens are in ICE custody pending removal proceedings.

“Our goal in conducting workplace compliance inspections is to verify that businesses are not employing people who do not have permission to work in the U.S.,” ICE San Juan Special Agent in Charge Rebecca González-Ramos said. 

“We will continue our collaboration efforts with local enforcement authorities to identify businesses that are breaking the immigration laws and will remove those individuals that are illegally present in our island.”
